## Purpose

Explain what changed, why it is needed and which decision or user it supports.

## Target Branch

- [ ] This is a core project change targeting `main`.
- [ ] This is a participant solution targeting `participant-review`.
- [ ] A participant solution does not target `main` directly.

## Affected Areas

- [ ] Case study or challenge documentation
- [ ] Participant submission
- [ ] Data or metadata
- [ ] SQL, SQLite or Python
- [ ] Excel, Power BI or Looker Studio
- [ ] Security or governance
- [ ] Release or citation

## Validation Completed

- [ ] Files open correctly.
- [ ] Paths are repository-relative.
- [ ] JSON and metadata parse correctly where applicable.
- [ ] CSV headers and formula-injection risk were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] No secret, private URL or real personal data was added.
- [ ] Canonical raw data was not silently overwritten.
- [ ] Synthetic-data status remains visible.
- [ ] Employee decisions remain subject to human review.
- [ ] Visual changes include screenshots.

## Evidence and Screenshots

Provide validation results, screenshots or links.

## Assumptions and Limitations

State any important assumption, unresolved issue or interpretation boundary.

## Risk and Rollback

Describe potential risk and how the change can be reversed.
